env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local

# Generated conditional closures must preserve lazy, once-only evaluation
# and pass cancellation back to their enclosing group child, including when
# they nest option heads and tails, end a switch arm in an option tail, or
# discard the results of an optional call. The native, ejected and upstream
# runs must each print every verdict marker of the shared program.
cp $GOROOT/test/logos/run/group_generated_receives.lgo a/main.lgo
cd a
logos run .
cmp stdout $GOROOT/test/logos/run/group_generated_receives.out
logos eject -o out
exists out/main.go
! exists out/main.lgo
cd out
go run .
cmp stdout $GOROOT/test/logos/run/group_generated_receives.out
exists $UPROOT1272/bin/go
exec $UPROOT1272/bin/go version
stdout '^go version go1\.27\.2 '
exec env -u GOROOT $UPROOT1272/bin/go run .
cmp stdout $GOROOT/test/logos/run/group_generated_receives.out
exec $GOROOT/bin/gofmt -l .
! stdout .

-- a/go.mod --
module example.com/groupgeneratedreceives

go 1.27
